description: This file declares the DrmSystemWidevine class, which adapts Widevine's Content Decryption Module to Starboard's DRM system interface. It includes method declarations for session management, decryption, and event handling, as well as internal data structures and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: DrmSystemWidevine
classes.description: A class that implements Widevine DRM integration for Starboard, handling session management, decryption, and event callbacks.

methods.name: DrmSystemWidevine
methods.description: Constructor initializing Widevine DRM system with context and callback functions.

methods.name: IsDrmSystemWidevine
methods.description: Checks if a given SbDrmSystem is Widevine.
